question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH item_by_order AS (
  SELECT ORDER_ID, COUNT(*) AS item_line_count, SUM(QUANTITY) AS ordered_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM
  GROUP BY ORDER_ID
), order_level AS (
  SELECT o.ORDER_ID,
         COALESCE(i.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
         COALESCE(i.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
  LEFT JOIN item_by_order i ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2025_orders,
       COUNT_IF(item_line_count = 0) AS orders_with_no_item_line,
       COUNT_IF(item_line_count = 1) AS one_line_orders,
       COUNT_IF(item_line_count > 1) AS multi_line_orders,
       ROUND(COUNT_IF(item_line_count > 1)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6) AS multi_line_order_share,
       ROUND(AVG(IFF(item_line_count = 1, ordered_units, NULL)), 6) AS avg_ordered_units_per_one_line_order,
       ROUND(AVG(IFF(item_line_count > 1, ordered_units, NULL)), 6) AS avg_ordered_units_per_multi_line_order
FROM order_level
action.metrics: 2025 order counts, multi-line share of all 2025 orders, and average ordered units per order by one-line versus multi-line orders

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 orders recorded in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 0.700057 of orders (70.005700%). One-line orders averaged 1.219753 ordered units per order (1,307,684 orders); multi-line orders averaged 3.484769 ordered units per order. There were 0 orders with no item line.
